capabilityHints.summary: Prices a content asset's live Dilution Risk Score into its pool: vetoes pool creation above a risk gate, charges a DRS-calibrated dynamic LP fee, pays JIT-proof per-position insurance claims from a self-funding reserve, and enforces the mandatory 10 bps Programmable fee non-bypassably on the canonical pool, quadrant-dependent (beforeSwap/afterSwap) so it is always denominated in the quote currency.

components.summary: Canonical eight-permission Uniswap v4 VeritasHook: DRS-gated pool creation, dynamic LP fee, per-position insurance claims, and quadrant-dependent Programmable/reserve fee collection.

project.summary: A Uniswap v4 hook that prices a content asset's live Dilution Risk Score (copies/AI replicas reducing scarcity) into its pool via a dynamic LP fee and a self-funding, JIT-proof LP insurance reserve, keeping the score alive on-chain trustlessly via Reactive Network.
project.title: Veritas
